messages.text: Read the hammer miner bc04 page

Ran these for Poland at about 20 cents a kWh. Say the word if you're mining somewhere else and I'll redo them.

BC04, $239, 6 TH/s at 100 W: about 8,600 sats a month, worth around $7.17 today, against $14.59 of power. Break-even BTC price $169,675. Solo block odds roughly 0.03% over a year.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405 W: about 43,000 sats a month ($35.86) against $59 of power, break-even $137,437, and 0.17% odds a year. Best break-even in the lineup.

At Polish rates none of these net a profit today, it's stacking sats and the jackpot shot. The B.04 is the cheap way in; the B30 is the one that actually moves the needle. It's pre-sale, ships October 30. Which way are you leaning?

Note: prices exclude 21% import VAT, charged on delivery.

context.pop: Hey, it's Sarah. Noticed you've been looking at Hammer Miner BC04 (6TH/s). Want me to run the numbers for where you live, or answer anything before you decide?
